note: Hand-written file contract for the R06 (Isaac) actors: normal enemies F1-F3 (32 px move loops) and the Sitnah well-keeper boss (64 px clips). Same rules as art 03 / R02-R05 for 32 px and as the R03 boss for 64 px (PPU 32, pivot (16,1) / (32,1), art faces right, flipX once on the parent, binary alpha). F1-F3 only chase and touch: no frontal invulnerability, shield, projectile or debuff art. The throw warning ring is NOT a PNG: see src/telegraph_r06.json. Gameplay numbers belong to Core and the catalog; they are quoted only where a clip's timing depends on them.
pivotSpace: pixel-edge coordinates, origin at the bottom-left corner of one frame cell, x right, y up
frameLayout: one horizontal strip per clip; frame i occupies x = i*cell.w .. (i+1)*cell.w, full height; no padding

flip.note: flip once on the actor's parent (or its single renderer), same rule as art 03 / R02-R05

alphaPolicies.binary: alpha is 0 or 255 only; RGB is 0 wherever alpha is 0

edgeMargin.why: no opaque pixel in the outer 1 px ring of a frame, so Point filtering and flipX never cut the outline; ground sprites stand on the foot row = cell.h - 1 - pivot.y (30 for 32 px, 62 for 64 px)

catalog.bossAttack: telegraphed_dirt_throw: cooldown 7 s, telegraph 1.2 s, damage 18, projectile_count 0

r03.why: the boss keeps the R03 slow-boss display radius 1.20, so the R03 boss shadow is reused unchanged instead of drawing a new one

assets.use: fast chase loop: a lean jackal-like raider sprinting with a stolen water skin on its back. Swarm enemy (also the boss's support summon); the water skin is look only
heavy chase loop: a squat burrowing beast hauling a heaped basket of dirt, shovel claws in front. The dirt stays on its back: it drops nothing and leaves no ground decal
slow chase loop: a hollow horned suit of plates stomping forward with an angry glow in the empty helm. It looks hard but has no shield and no closed front: F3 has no frontal invulnerability
slow chase; also the boss intro, holding frame 0. A living stone well whose mouth is choked with dirt, a bucket hanging on a chain from the rim

the 1.2 s dirt-throw warning (Core: warning from boss elapsed 5.8 s in each 7 s cycle, the boss stops and the player position is locked). Driven by the Core telegraph clock, not by fps: frame k from telegraph elapsed k*0.4 s; frame 2 (heap held overhead) is held until impact. The danger ring is drawn separately from Core, see src/telegraph_r06.json
starts on the Core impact tick (warning end), plays once (0.2 s), then back to move. The heap leaves the hands; the flight arc and any fallen dirt are Unity visuals only and are not in this clip

plays once on the boss kill: the keeper breaks apart and the filled well flows again; the last frame (an open stone well with clear water) may be held or faded by Unity. It is not terrain and does not block movement

notProduced.warning ring PNG: none on purpose: the ring is drawn procedurally from the Core target and radius (src/telegraph_r06.json)
notProduced.dirt clod in flight / fallen dirt decal: not made in this round. The arc and the fallen dirt are a Unity visual only, decoration, never path-blocking or lasting-damage terrain. If root wants a sprite later, a separate small fx proposal (a 16 px binary clod plus a short scatter that fades) would need its own contract
notProduced.summon effect for the F1 support waves: the 70% / 35% F1 summons use the F1 move clip and the shared enemy spawn handling; no extra summon art
notProduced.F1-F3 hit / death clips: not in the R06 brief; the existing shared enemy hit/death handling applies
notProduced.new boss shadow: the R03 40x8 boss shadow is reused unchanged (same display radius 1.20)

motifs.source: Genesis 26:15-22 (the wells filled with dirt, the quarrels over water at Esek and Sitnah, then Rehoboth). Sitnah is the name of a well, not a person. Creative adaptation for the game.
motifs.f1: the stolen water of the well quarrels as a lean jackal-like raider carrying a water skin (a created monster; not the herdsmen of Gerar or any people)
motifs.f2: the filling of the wells as a burrowing beast hauling dirt (a created monster; not the Philistines)
motifs.f3: the quarrel itself as a hollow suit of horned armour, empty inside (a created monster; not a soldier or any person)
motifs.boss: the Sitnah well-keeper: a created monster built from well stones, the dirt that chokes the well and a bucket chain. On defeat the well flows again
motifs.excluded: Isaac, Rebekah, Abraham, Abimelech, Phicol, the Philistines, the herdsmen, Isaac's servants and God are never enemies or enemy effects, and no biblical person is drawn as a demon. No human figures are drawn
